rows.grounds: Numeral element forming the compound number eighty-four thousand.
Locative plural indicating the numerical magnitude in which the condition occurs.
Compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device), denoting realms or apparatuses of birth.
Past passive participle describing beings subjected to affliction.

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: Beings are situated within these womb-mechanisms.
These beings are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings located in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms undergo torment.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is not explicitly named in this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
